title: dryopteris biformis
intro: Dryopteris biformis, commonly known as the two-formed fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris biformis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
